complexity.notes: The try/except-as-control-flow works but is convoluted: the sorted case is better handled by a plain range(len(nums) - 1) loop with a return of nums[0] after it, and a bare except is never good practice. Since the array is sorted apart from one break, the problem's stated challenge — O(log n) — is achievable with ||binary search: compare the middle element to the right end to decide which half contains the rotation point||.
complexity.summary: Scans left to right for the single position where an element exceeds its successor — that successor is the minimum. If the loop reaches the last index, an IndexError fires and a bare except returns nums[0], which covers the unrotated (fully sorted) case.
